diagrams.title: OBSERVER PATTERN
notes: SUBJECT HOLDS A LIST OF OBSERVERS AND NOTIFIES EACH ONE WHEN ITS STATE CHANGES.
OBSERVERS ATTACH AND DETACH AT RUN TIME; THE SUBJECT NEVER DEPENDS ON CONCRETE TYPES.
CONCRETE OBSERVERS PULL THE STATE THEY NEED AFTER UPDATE() IS CALLED.

diagrams.title: MODEL · VIEW · CONTROLLER
notes: THE CONTROLLER TRANSLATES USER INPUT INTO OPERATIONS ON THE MODEL.
THE MODEL HOLDS STATE AND RULES AND KNOWS NOTHING ABOUT THE VIEW.
THE VIEW RENDERS THE MODEL AND REFRESHES WHEN NOTIFIED OF A CHANGE.

diagrams.title: LAYERED ARCHITECTURE
notes: EACH LAYER MAY CALL ONLY THE LAYER DIRECTLY BENEATH IT.
THE DOMAIN LAYER CONTAINS THE BUSINESS RULES AND NO FRAMEWORK CODE.
INFRASTRUCTURE IMPLEMENTS THE INTERFACES THE UPPER LAYERS DECLARE.

diagrams.title: HEXAGONAL ARCHITECTURE
notes: THE CORE DEFINES PORTS: INTERFACES FOR EVERYTHING IT NEEDS OR OFFERS.
DRIVING ADAPTERS CALL INBOUND PORTS; DRIVEN ADAPTERS IMPLEMENT OUTBOUND PORTS.
ALL DEPENDENCIES POINT INWARD, SO THE CORE IS TESTABLE WITHOUT I/O.

diagrams.title: MICROSERVICES
notes: EACH SERVICE OWNS ITS DATA; NO OTHER SERVICE READS ITS DATABASE DIRECTLY.
THE GATEWAY HANDLES ROUTING, AUTHENTICATION AND RATE LIMITING.
SERVICES PUBLISH DOMAIN EVENTS TO THE BUS INSTEAD OF CALLING EACH OTHER.

diagrams.title: EVENT SOURCING
notes: STATE IS NEVER STORED DIRECTLY; IT IS DERIVED BY REPLAYING EVENTS IN ORDER.
EVENTS ARE IMMUTABLE FACTS. THE APPEND-ONLY LOG IS THE SOURCE OF TRUTH.
PROJECTIONS MAY BE DROPPED AND REBUILT FROM THE LOG AT ANY TIME.

diagrams.title: CQRS
notes: COMMANDS CHANGE STATE AND RETURN NOTHING; QUERIES RETURN DATA AND CHANGE NOTHING.
THE READ STORE IS DENORMALIZED FOR THE SCREENS THAT READ IT.
THE TWO SIDES ARE EVENTUALLY CONSISTENT; THE DELAY IS A DESIGN DECISION.

diagrams.title: PUBLISH · SUBSCRIBE
notes: PUBLISHERS WRITE TO A TOPIC AND NEVER LEARN WHO, IF ANYONE, IS LISTENING.
THE BROKER FANS EACH MESSAGE OUT TO EVERY CURRENT SUBSCRIBER.
SUBSCRIBERS CAN BE ADDED WITHOUT TOUCHING THE PUBLISHERS.

diagrams.title: PIPES AND FILTERS
notes: EVERY FILTER READS FROM ONE PIPE AND WRITES TO THE NEXT; NO SHARED STATE.
FILTERS ARE INDEPENDENT, SO THEY CAN BE REORDERED, REPLACED OR RUN IN PARALLEL.
BACKPRESSURE IN THE PIPES KEEPS A FAST PRODUCER FROM FLOODING A SLOW FILTER.

diagrams.title: LOAD-BALANCED WEB TIER
notes: APP SERVERS HOLD NO SESSION STATE, SO ANY OF THEM CAN SERVE ANY REQUEST.
THE BALANCER HEALTH-CHECKS EACH SERVER AND DROPS THE ONES THAT FAIL.
READS MAY GO TO THE REPLICA; ALL WRITES GO TO THE PRIMARY.

diagrams.title: CIRCUIT BREAKER
notes: WHILE CLOSED, CALLS PASS THROUGH AND FAILURES ARE COUNTED.
WHEN THE COUNT PASSES THE THRESHOLD THE BREAKER OPENS AND FAILS FAST.
AFTER A TIMEOUT ONE PROBE CALL IS ALLOWED; SUCCESS CLOSES THE BREAKER AGAIN.

diagrams.title: REPOSITORY PATTERN
notes: THE DOMAIN TALKS TO A COLLECTION-LIKE INTERFACE, NOT TO SQL OR AN ORM.
EACH IMPLEMENTATION HIDES ONE STORAGE TECHNOLOGY BEHIND THE SAME CONTRACT.
TESTS SWAP IN THE IN-MEMORY IMPLEMENTATION AND RUN WITHOUT A DATABASE.

diagrams.title: SAGA · ORCHESTRATION
notes: THE ORCHESTRATOR DRIVES EACH LOCAL TRANSACTION IN TURN AND RECORDS PROGRESS.
EVERY STEP HAS A COMPENSATING ACTION THAT UNDOES IT.
ON FAILURE THE COMPLETED STEPS ARE COMPENSATED IN REVERSE ORDER.

diagrams.title: CACHE-ASIDE
notes: THE APPLICATION CHECKS THE CACHE FIRST AND RETURNS ON A HIT.
ON A MISS IT READS THE DATABASE, THEN WRITES THE RESULT INTO THE CACHE.
ENTRIES EXPIRE BY TTL OR ARE EVICTED WHEN THE UNDERLYING ROW CHANGES.

diagrams.title: STRATEGY PATTERN
notes: THE CONTEXT DELEGATES THE VARYING STEP TO A STRATEGY OBJECT.
ALL STRATEGIES SHARE ONE INTERFACE, SO THEY ARE INTERCHANGEABLE AT RUN TIME.
THE CLIENT PICKS THE STRATEGY; THE CONTEXT NEVER BRANCHES ON TYPE.

diagrams.title: FACTORY METHOD
notes: THE CREATOR DEFINES AN OPERATION THAT NEEDS A PRODUCT BUT DEFERS WHICH ONE.
SUBCLASSES OVERRIDE THE FACTORY METHOD TO RETURN THEIR OWN PRODUCT TYPE.
CLIENT CODE WORKS AGAINST THE PRODUCT INTERFACE ONLY.

diagrams.title: DECORATOR PATTERN
notes: A DECORATOR IMPLEMENTS THE COMPONENT INTERFACE AND HOLDS ANOTHER COMPONENT.
IT FORWARDS EACH CALL TO THE WRAPPED OBJECT, ADDING BEHAVIOR BEFORE OR AFTER.
DECORATORS STACK, SO FEATURES COMBINE WITHOUT A SUBCLASS EXPLOSION.

diagrams.title: WORK QUEUE
notes: THE PRODUCER ENQUEUES JOBS AND RETURNS AT ONCE; WORKERS PULL AT THEIR OWN PACE.
ADD WORKERS TO RAISE THROUGHPUT; NOTHING ELSE CHANGES.
A JOB THAT FAILS REPEATEDLY IS PARKED IN THE DEAD LETTER QUEUE FOR INSPECTION.

diagrams.title: SIDECAR
notes: THE SIDECAR RUNS BESIDE THE APPLICATION, SHARING ITS HOST AND LIFECYCLE.
IT TAKES ON CROSS-CUTTING WORK: TLS, RETRIES, LOG SHIPPING, SERVICE DISCOVERY.
THE APPLICATION TALKS PLAIN HTTP TO LOCALHOST AND STAYS LANGUAGE-AGNOSTIC.

diagrams.title: ADAPTER PATTERN
notes: THE CLIENT SPEAKS ONLY TO THE TARGET INTERFACE IT ALREADY KNOWS.
THE ADAPTER IMPLEMENTS THAT INTERFACE AND TRANSLATES EACH CALL.
THE ADAPTEE, OFTEN A LEGACY OR THIRD-PARTY API, IS LEFT UNTOUCHED.

diagrams.title: FACADE PATTERN
notes: THE FACADE OFFERS ONE SIMPLE ENTRY POINT TO A COMPLICATED SUBSYSTEM.
CLIENTS NEVER TOUCH THE PARTS BEHIND IT, SO THOSE PARTS CAN CHANGE FREELY.
THE SUBSYSTEM STAYS USABLE DIRECTLY WHEN FINE CONTROL IS NEEDED.

diagrams.title: PROXY PATTERN
notes: THE PROXY IMPLEMENTS THE SAME INTERFACE AS THE REAL SUBJECT.
IT ADDS CONTROL: ACCESS CHECKS, CACHING, LAZY LOADING, REMOTE CALLS.
THE CLIENT CANNOT TELL WHICH ONE IT IS TALKING TO.

diagrams.title: COMMAND PATTERN
notes: A REQUEST BECOMES AN OBJECT WITH EXECUTE() AND UNDO().
THE INVOKER TRIGGERS COMMANDS WITHOUT KNOWING WHAT THEY DO.
EXECUTED COMMANDS GO ON A STACK, WHICH IS WHAT MAKES UNDO POSSIBLE.

diagrams.title: MEDIATOR PATTERN
notes: COLLEAGUES TALK ONLY TO THE MEDIATOR, NEVER TO EACH OTHER.
THE MEDIATOR HOLDS THE INTERACTION RULES IN ONE PLACE.
ADDING A COLLEAGUE CHANGES ONE CLASS INSTEAD OF N.

diagrams.title: CHAIN OF RESPONSIBILITY
notes: EACH HANDLER EITHER DEALS WITH THE REQUEST OR PASSES IT TO THE NEXT.
THE SENDER KNOWS ONLY THE FIRST LINK; THE CHAIN IS ASSEMBLED AT RUN TIME.
A HANDLER MAY STOP THE CHAIN, AS RATE LIMITING DOES HERE.

dimensions.label: EACH LINK PASSES ON OR STOPS

diagrams.title: BUILDER PATTERN
notes: THE BUILDER ASSEMBLES A COMPLEX PRODUCT ONE STEP AT A TIME.
THE DIRECTOR KNOWS THE ORDER OF STEPS, NOT THE PRODUCT'S PARTS.
DIFFERENT BUILDERS YIELD DIFFERENT PRODUCTS FROM THE SAME STEPS.

diagrams.title: COMPOSITE PATTERN
notes: LEAVES AND COMPOSITES SHARE ONE INTERFACE, SO CLIENTS TREAT THEM ALIKE.
A COMPOSITE FORWARDS EACH OPERATION TO ITS CHILDREN.
THE RESULT IS A TREE THAT CAN BE NESTED TO ANY DEPTH.

dimensions.label: A TREE OF PARTS TREATED ALIKE

diagrams.title: STATE PATTERN
notes: THE CONTEXT DELEGATES EACH REQUEST TO ITS CURRENT STATE OBJECT.
EACH STATE CLASS HOLDS THE BEHAVIOUR FOR ONE STATE AND PICKS THE NEXT.
NO SWITCH STATEMENTS: A NEW STATE IS A NEW CLASS.

diagrams.title: TEMPLATE METHOD
notes: THE BASE CLASS FIXES THE SKELETON OF THE ALGORITHM.
SUBCLASSES OVERRIDE INDIVIDUAL STEPS, NEVER THE SKELETON.
HOLLYWOOD PRINCIPLE: DON'T CALL US, WE'LL CALL YOU.

nodes.label: DATA EXPORTER
nodes.detail:
EXPORT() { OPEN(); WRITE(); CLOSE(); }
OPEN()   WRITE()   CLOSE()

diagrams.title: DEPENDENCY INJECTION
notes: THE COMPOSITION ROOT BUILDS THE OBJECT GRAPH; NOTHING ELSE CALLS NEW ON A DEPENDENCY.
CLASSES ASK FOR INTERFACES IN THEIR CONSTRUCTORS AND GET IMPLEMENTATIONS HANDED IN.
TESTS INJECT FAKES THROUGH THE SAME CONSTRUCTORS.

diagrams.title: BULKHEAD
notes: EACH KIND OF WORK GETS ITS OWN POOL OF THREADS OR CONNECTIONS.
A FLOOD OR STALL IN ONE POOL CANNOT EXHAUST THE OTHER.
NAMED AFTER THE WATERTIGHT COMPARTMENTS OF A SHIP'S HULL.

dimensions.label: A STALL IN B NEVER STARVES A

diagrams.title: RETRY WITH BACKOFF
notes: ONLY TRANSIENT ERRORS ARE RETRIED; A 400 IS NOT GOING TO GET BETTER.
EACH WAIT DOUBLES, WITH JITTER, SO RETRIES DON'T ARRIVE IN A SYNCHRONISED WAVE.
AFTER THE LAST ATTEMPT THE CALLER FAILS FAST AND SAYS SO.

dimensions.label: GIVE UP AFTER THE LAST ATTEMPT · FAIL FAST

diagrams.title: TRANSACTIONAL OUTBOX
notes: THE BUSINESS ROW AND ITS EVENT ARE WRITTEN IN ONE LOCAL TRANSACTION.
A RELAY READS THE OUTBOX TABLE AND PUBLISHES, THEN MARKS EACH ROW SENT.
NO DUAL WRITE: EITHER BOTH HAPPEN OR NEITHER DOES.

diagrams.title: CLEAN ARCHITECTURE
notes: SOURCE CODE DEPENDENCIES POINT INWARD ONLY; INNER RINGS KNOW NOTHING OF OUTER ONES.
ENTITIES HOLD ENTERPRISE RULES; USE CASES HOLD APPLICATION RULES.
FRAMEWORKS, DATABASES AND THE WEB ARE DETAILS KEPT AT THE EDGE.

diagrams.title: MICROKERNEL · PLUG-INS
notes: THE CORE IS SMALL AND STABLE: LIFECYCLE, REGISTRY AND THE PLUG-IN CONTRACT.
FEATURES ARRIVE AS PLUG-INS THAT ARE DISCOVERED AND LOADED AT START-UP.
PLUG-INS DEPEND ON THE CORE, NEVER ON EACH OTHER.

diagrams.title: BACKEND FOR FRONTEND
notes: EACH FRONTEND GETS A BACKEND SHAPED FOR ITS SCREENS AND BANDWIDTH.
THE BFF AGGREGATES SEVERAL SERVICES INTO ONE CALL AND TRIMS THE PAYLOAD.
THE FRONTEND TEAM OWNS ITS BFF, SO IT CHANGES WITHOUT A CROSS-TEAM QUEUE.

diagrams.title: STRANGLER FIG
notes: A FACADE IN FRONT OF THE MONOLITH ROUTES EACH REQUEST OLD OR NEW.
FEATURES MOVE ONE AT A TIME; EACH MOVE IS SMALL AND REVERSIBLE.
WHEN THE LAST ROUTE HAS MOVED, THE MONOLITH IS SWITCHED OFF.

diagrams.title: BLUE-GREEN DEPLOYMENT
notes: TWO IDENTICAL ENVIRONMENTS; ONLY ONE TAKES TRAFFIC AT A TIME.
THE NEW VERSION IS DEPLOYED AND TESTED ON THE IDLE SIDE FIRST.
THE RELEASE IS A ROUTER FLIP, AND SO IS THE ROLLBACK.

dimensions.label: FLIP TO RELEASE · FLIP BACK TO RECOVER

diagrams.title: CANARY RELEASE
notes: A SMALL SLICE OF REAL TRAFFIC HITS THE NEW VERSION FIRST.
ERRORS AND LATENCY ARE COMPARED AGAINST THE STABLE FLEET.
THE SLICE GROWS STEP BY STEP, OR THE CANARY IS PULLED.

diagrams.title: SERVICE DISCOVERY
notes: INSTANCES REGISTER ON START AND HEARTBEAT; SILENCE REMOVES THEM.
CLIENTS LOOK UP A NAME AND GET THE LIVE ADDRESSES BACK.
ADDRESSES CHANGE WITH EVERY DEPLOY; NAMES DO NOT.

diagrams.title: CONSISTENT HASHING
notes: KEYS AND NODES ARE HASHED ONTO THE SAME RING; A KEY BELONGS TO THE NEXT NODE CLOCKWISE.
ADDING OR REMOVING A NODE MOVES ONLY THE KEYS IN ITS ARC, NOT 1/N OF EVERYTHING.
VIRTUAL NODES SPREAD EACH SERVER AROUND THE RING TO EVEN OUT THE LOAD.

diagrams.title: LEADER ELECTION
notes: ONE LEADER PER TERM ACCEPTS WRITES AND REPLICATES THEM TO FOLLOWERS.
A FOLLOWER THAT HEARS NO HEARTBEAT STARTS AN ELECTION FOR THE NEXT TERM.
A WRITE IS COMMITTED ONCE A MAJORITY HAS IT, SO TWO LEADERS CAN NEVER BOTH WIN.

diagrams.title: MAPREDUCE
notes: MAPPERS TURN EACH INPUT SPLIT INTO KEY-VALUE PAIRS, INDEPENDENTLY AND IN PARALLEL.
THE SHUFFLE GROUPS EVERY VALUE FOR A KEY ONTO ONE REDUCER.
REDUCERS FOLD EACH GROUP INTO A RESULT; FAILED TASKS ARE SIMPLY RERUN.

diagrams.title: COMPILER PIPELINE
notes: THE FRONT END UNDERSTANDS THE LANGUAGE: CHARACTERS TO TOKENS TO A TYPED TREE.
THE INTERMEDIATE REPRESENTATION LETS ONE BACK END SERVE MANY LANGUAGES.
EACH STAGE HAS ONE INPUT AND ONE OUTPUT, SO EACH CAN BE TESTED ALONE.

diagrams.title: NETWORK STACK
notes: EACH LAYER TALKS LOGICALLY TO ITS PEER AND PHYSICALLY ONLY TO ITS NEIGHBOURS.
GOING DOWN, EVERY LAYER WRAPS THE DATA IN ITS OWN HEADER; GOING UP, IT UNWRAPS.
ONLY THE LINK LAYER CARRIES REAL BITS BETWEEN THE HOSTS.

diagrams.title: SHARDING
notes: THE ROUTER MAPS EACH KEY TO ONE SHARD, SO EVERY SHARD HOLDS A SLICE OF THE DATA.
SHARDS SCALE WRITES AND STORAGE; CROSS-SHARD QUERIES BECOME THE HARD PART.
PICK THE SHARD KEY FOR EVEN LOAD, NOT FOR ALPHABETICAL NEATNESS.

diagrams.title: ABSTRACT FACTORY
notes: ONE FACTORY INTERFACE CREATES A WHOLE FAMILY OF RELATED PRODUCTS.
EACH CONCRETE FACTORY YIELDS PRODUCTS THAT ARE GUARANTEED TO MATCH.
THE CLIENT PICKS A FACTORY ONCE AND NEVER NAMES A CONCRETE PRODUCT.

diagrams.title: PROTOTYPE PATTERN
notes: NEW OBJECTS ARE MADE BY COPYING A CONFIGURED EXAMPLE, NOT BY CALLING A CONSTRUCTOR.
EACH CLASS KNOWS HOW TO CLONE ITSELF, DEEP OR SHALLOW AS IT SEES FIT.
A REGISTRY OF NAMED PROTOTYPES REPLACES A GROWING FAMILY OF FACTORIES.

diagrams.title: SINGLETON PATTERN
notes: THE CONSTRUCTOR IS PRIVATE; GET_INSTANCE() CREATES THE ONE OBJECT ON FIRST USE.
EVERY CALLER SHARES THE SAME INSTANCE AND ITS STATE.
USE SPARINGLY: IT IS GLOBAL STATE, AND TESTS FIND IT HARD TO REPLACE.

diagrams.title: BRIDGE PATTERN
notes: THE ABSTRACTION HOLDS A REFERENCE TO AN IMPLEMENTOR INSTEAD OF INHERITING FROM IT.
BOTH SIDES GROW ON THEIR OWN: NEW REMOTES, NEW DEVICES, NO M × N SUBCLASSES.
THE BRIDGE IS THE COMPOSITION ARROW IN THE MIDDLE.

diagrams.title: FLYWEIGHT PATTERN
notes: INTRINSIC STATE (THE GLYPH'S SHAPE) IS SHARED; EXTRINSIC STATE (POSITION, COLOUR) IS PASSED IN.
THE FACTORY HANDS OUT ONE SHARED OBJECT PER DISTINCT INTRINSIC STATE.
A MILLION CHARACTERS NEED ONLY A FEW DOZEN GLYPH OBJECTS.

nodes.label: GLYPH
nodes.detail:
INTRINSIC: SHAPE, FONT
DRAW(X, Y, COLOUR)

diagrams.title: INTERPRETER PATTERN
notes: EACH GRAMMAR RULE BECOMES A CLASS; A SENTENCE BECOMES A TREE OF THEM.
TERMINALS EVALUATE THEMSELVES; NON-TERMINALS EVALUATE THEIR CHILDREN AND COMBINE.
GOOD FOR SMALL LANGUAGES: FILTERS, FORMULAS, RULES.

diagrams.title: ITERATOR PATTERN
notes: THE COLLECTION HANDS OUT AN ITERATOR INSTEAD OF EXPOSING ITS NODES OR ARRAY.
HAS_NEXT() AND NEXT() ARE ALL A CLIENT NEEDS, FOR ANY COLLECTION.
SEVERAL ITERATORS MAY WALK THE SAME COLLECTION AT ONCE.

diagrams.title: MEMENTO PATTERN
notes: THE ORIGINATOR PACKS ITS STATE INTO A MEMENTO ONLY IT CAN READ.
THE CARETAKER KEEPS MEMENTOS WITHOUT LOOKING INSIDE THEM.
RESTORE HANDS ONE BACK, AND THE ORIGINATOR REWINDS ITSELF.

diagrams.title: VISITOR PATTERN
notes: ACCEPT(VISITOR) ON EACH ELEMENT CALLS BACK VISIT(THIS), PICKING THE RIGHT OVERLOAD.
A NEW OPERATION IS A NEW VISITOR CLASS; THE ELEMENTS STAY UNTOUCHED.
A NEW ELEMENT TYPE, HOWEVER, TOUCHES EVERY VISITOR: THE TRADE-OFF.

dimensions.label: NEW OPERATIONS WITHOUT TOUCHING THE ELEMENTS

diagrams.title: UNIT OF WORK
notes: THE UNIT OF WORK TRACKS EVERY OBJECT TOUCHED DURING A BUSINESS OPERATION.
COMMIT() WRITES ALL INSERTS, UPDATES AND DELETES IN ONE TRANSACTION, IN THE RIGHT ORDER.
NOTHING REACHES THE DATABASE UNTIL THEN, SO A FAILURE LEAVES IT UNTOUCHED.

diagrams.title: SPECIFICATION PATTERN
notes: A BUSINESS RULE BECOMES AN OBJECT WITH ONE QUESTION: IS_SATISFIED_BY(CANDIDATE)?
SPECIFICATIONS COMBINE WITH AND, OR AND NOT INTO LARGER RULES.
THE SAME SPECIFICATION SELECTS IN MEMORY, VALIDATES INPUT, OR BECOMES A QUERY.

diagrams.title: ANTI-CORRUPTION LAYER
notes: OUR MODEL NEVER SEES THE LEGACY SYSTEM'S NAMES, TYPES OR QUIRKS.
THE LAYER TRANSLATES BOTH WAYS: A FACADE, ADAPTERS AND MAPPERS.
WHEN THE LEGACY SYSTEM IS REPLACED, ONLY THE LAYER CHANGES.

diagrams.title: BOUNDED CONTEXTS
notes: THE SAME WORD MEANS DIFFERENT THINGS IN DIFFERENT CONTEXTS; EACH GETS ITS OWN MODEL.
CONTEXTS INTEGRATE THROUGH EVENTS AND CONTRACTS, NOT A SHARED DATABASE.
A SHARED KERNEL IS KEPT SMALL AND CHANGED ONLY BY AGREEMENT.

diagrams.title: DOMAIN EVENTS
notes: AN AGGREGATE RECORDS WHAT HAPPENED, IN THE PAST TENSE, AS IT CHANGES STATE.
THE DISPATCHER PUBLISHES THOSE EVENTS AFTER THE TRANSACTION COMMITS.
HANDLERS REACT WITHOUT THE AGGREGATE KNOWING THEY EXIST.

diagrams.title: TWO-PHASE COMMIT
notes: PHASE 1: THE COORDINATOR ASKS EVERY PARTICIPANT TO PREPARE; EACH VOTES YES OR NO.
PHASE 2: ALL YES → COMMIT EVERYWHERE; ANY NO → ABORT EVERYWHERE.
A COORDINATOR CRASH BETWEEN PHASES LEAVES PARTICIPANTS BLOCKED; HENCE SAGAS.

dimensions.label: PHASE 2: COMMIT OR ABORT, TO ALL

diagrams.title: IDEMPOTENT CONSUMER
notes: AT-LEAST-ONCE DELIVERY MEANS THE SAME MESSAGE WILL ARRIVE TWICE SOONER OR LATER.
THE CONSUMER REMEMBERS PROCESSED MESSAGE IDS AND SKIPS REPEATS.
THE ID CHECK AND THE EFFECT HAPPEN IN ONE TRANSACTION, OR THE GAP LETS A DUPLICATE THROUGH.

nodes.label: CONSUMER
nodes.detail:
SEEN IDS TABLE
IF SEEN → SKIP

diagrams.title: ACTOR MODEL
notes: AN ACTOR HAS PRIVATE STATE AND A MAILBOX; IT HANDLES ONE MESSAGE AT A TIME.
ACTORS SHARE NOTHING, SO THERE ARE NO LOCKS AND NO DATA RACES.
AN ACTOR MAY SEND MESSAGES, SPAWN ACTORS, OR CHANGE HOW IT HANDLES THE NEXT MESSAGE.

diagrams.title: EVENT LOOP · REACTOR
notes: ONE THREAD WAITS ON MANY SOURCES AT ONCE AND WAKES ONLY WHEN SOMETHING IS READY.
EACH READY EVENT IS DISPATCHED TO ITS HANDLER, WHICH MUST RETURN QUICKLY.
A SLOW HANDLER BLOCKS EVERYTHING; LONG WORK GOES TO A THREAD POOL.

diagrams.title: LAMBDA ARCHITECTURE
notes: EVERY EVENT IS APPENDED TO AN IMMUTABLE MASTER DATASET AND ALSO STREAMED.
THE BATCH LAYER RECOMPUTES EXACT VIEWS FROM SCRATCH; THE SPEED LAYER PATCHES THE LAST FEW MINUTES.
THE SERVING LAYER MERGES BOTH, SO QUERIES ARE COMPLETE AND FRESH.
